mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.case_status status,c.version FROM admin_case c WHERE c.id=#{caseId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation rel WHERE rel.admin_case_id=c.id AND rel.is_primary=1 AND ( (c.case_type='fulfillment_risk' AND rel.relation_type='fulfillment_risk' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_risk r WHERE r.id=rel.relation_id)) OR (c.case_type='custom_after_sale' AND rel.relation_type='custom_after_sale_request' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_after_sale_request a WHERE a.id=rel.relation_id AND a.admin_case_id=c.id)) OR (c.case_type='custom_fulfillment' AND rel.relation_type='custom_order_extension_request' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_order_extension_request e WHERE e.id=rel.relation_id AND e.admin_case_id=c.id)) )) FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT relation_type,relation_id FROM admin_case_relation WHERE admin_case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY relation_type,relation_id

SELECT after_snapshot_json FROM admin_operation_audit WHERE admin_user_id=#{actor} AND operation_code='case_contact_record' AND target_type='admin_case' AND target_id=#{caseId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT n.id,n.contact_channel channel,n.note_content summary,n.created_at at,a.after_snapshot_json snapshot FROM admin_case_note n LEFT JOIN admin_operation_audit a ON a.target_type='admin_case' AND a.target_id=n.admin_case_id AND a.operation_code='case_contact_record' AND a.after_snapshot_json->>'$.result.noteId'=n.id WHERE n.admin_case_id=#{caseId} AND n.note_type='contact_record' ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_case SET version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{caseId} AND version=#{version}
